name: Darien, King of Kjeldor
oracle_text: Whenever you're dealt damage, you may create that many 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you're dealt damage, you may create that many 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.

needs.what: a trigger on the player half of DAMAGE_DEALT (to="player") keyed on the VICTIM seat ('whenever you're dealt damage'), firing once per damage event with `amount` summed across every source that dealt damage simultaneously (510.2 combat damage from several attackers is one event, one trigger, 'that many' = the total), and firing for damage from any source, including one with no source object
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `deals_damage_to_player` with `controller: "any"` and `defending: "you"` hears the right half, but its subject is the dealer: it fires once per source (three unblocked attackers make three triggers and three separate 'may' prompts instead of one trigger for the total), it refuses sourceless damage (`subject_oid is None`), and `batched` only sums `amount` for `dealt_damage` (`_joins_batched_damage`), so batching it would dedupe the firings and drop all but the first source's damage. `dealt_damage` is the permanent half only (`EVENT_HALVES`), and `life_lost` fires on non-damage life loss and misses infect damage
